blind.description: A thick, closed hardcover tome lying flat on the floor, wrapped securely with criss-crossing metal chains locked with a central metal plate/lock. It features dark red leather covers with metallic corner brackets and aged cream-colored paper pages visible on three sides. Surfaces are clean, solid, and fully textured with no floating or broken elements.
blind.from_above: A vertically-oriented rectangular dark red book cover with metallic reinforced corner tabs, crossed symmetrically by an iron chain in a plus-shape centered on a square metal lock plate.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 4 to 6 inches thick (roughly 1/15 the figure's height) and about 1 foot long by 0.8 feet wide.

notes: gemini note: slightly thicker than catalog proportions
